info.title: Project API
info.description:
## What are projects?

Projects are the general container for your development of a specific
product or service. You can have as many projects as you like, and each
project can be shared or owned by one or more organizations or be a personal
project.

Projects let you contain common settings and preferences to streamline your
development. They also contain the billing information and usage information
important to understand how your products and services are consuming or utilizing
resources.

## What can you do with the Project API?

* Create and manage your development process
* Link projects to initiatives in your organization
* Deploy and manage the lifecycle of your applications and services
* Organize your development process.
-----
